Insight pointers

Data-backed speaking points for the brand team.

01

Face Wash is primarily entering as a problem-solution product.

Problem-solution46 / 67
Routine cleansing14 / 67
Enhancement / maintenance7 / 67

Pointer: Lead with targeted acne, oil, pores and marks problem-solving rather than basic cleansing.

Consumer verbatim: “I expected clearer skin and more noticeable reduction in marks.”
02

Slow or limited visible results are the largest friction in use.

Slow / limited results23 / 62
Fragrance13 / 62
Dryness / over-cleansing9 / 62

Pointer: Set clearer result timelines while reducing dryness and fragrance-related friction.

Consumer verbatim: “Expected fewer active pimples and faster improvement in acne marks.”
03

The brand is perceived through ingredients, science and clinical credibility.

Ingredients11 / 57
Science10 / 57
Clinical10 / 57
Instagram discovery18 / 62

Pointer: Use social discovery to bring consumers into ingredient- and science-led proof.

Consumer verbatim: “Oil control improved a little, with no major change in marks.”

Data note: multi-answer responses can overlap. State comparisons are directional where bases are small. Q7 brand-perception bar charts are recalculated from the current uploaded workbook.
